issues.problem: A reader looking up “why bow on the phone” is told telepathy, sacred phones, national trance, and spiritual technology many times. The myth stays in the mouth even as it is denied.
issues.suggestion: Bust the tourist story once in the short answer and once in FAQ. Elsewhere describe habit, scripts, and being watched at work.
